patch:
@@ -30,10 +30,14 @@ jobs:
       - name: Run tests with coverage (mini-testing + mini-runtime + deps)
         run: mvn -B package -pl apps/mini-testing,apps/mini-runtime -am
 
-      # Pinned to the v1.8.0 release commit (not a mutable tag) for supply-chain safety.
+      # Pinned to an unreleased main commit, not a tagged release: v1.8.0's
+      # "coverage-changed-files" output is actually whole-file coverage (including
+      # all pre-existing untested code in any file you touch), not real diff coverage.
+      # This commit renames it to coverage-changed-lines and fixes it to mean what it
+      # says - "the coverage of lines that were changed in the PR".
       - name: Post coverage report on the PR
         id: jacoco
-        uses: Madrapps/jacoco-report@e51ce1f46f7f8b5331593f935e59cbaf44b84920 # v1.8.0
+        uses: Madrapps/jacoco-report@2d0aea11fcfac3fff0987ff855c4a59c8903f8ff # main, unreleased
         with:
           paths: |
             ${{ github.workspace }}/apps/mini-testing/target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml
@@ -45,17 +49,17 @@ jobs:
           comment-type: both
           skip-if-no-changes: true
           min-coverage-overall: 50
-          min-coverage-changed-files: 50
+          min-coverage-changed-lines: 50
 
       - name: Fail if changed-lines coverage is below 50%
         run: |
-          COVERAGE="${{ steps.jacoco.outputs.coverage-changed-files }}"
+          COVERAGE="${{ steps.jacoco.outputs.coverage-changed-lines }}"
 
           if [ -z "$COVERAGE" ]; then
-            echo "No changed-files coverage reported (no coverable lines in this diff) - nothing to gate on."
+            echo "No changed-lines coverage reported (no coverable lines in this diff) - nothing to gate on."
             exit 0
           fi
 
-          echo "Changed-files coverage: ${COVERAGE}%"
+          echo "Changed-lines coverage: ${COVERAGE}%"
           awk -v c="$COVERAGE" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 >= 50) }' \
             || { echo "::error::Patch coverage on changed lines is ${COVERAGE}%, below the 50% minimum."; exit 1; }

@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@ jobs:
             exit 1
           fi
 
-      - name: PR description check (>=10 non-empty lines)
+      - name: PR description check (>=100 words)
         id: description
         continue-on-error: true
         env:
@@ -44,14 +44,18 @@ jobs:
           import os
           import re
 
+          # Word count instead of raw newline count: a well-written description as a
+          # few wrapped prose paragraphs has far fewer literal "\n"s than a sparse
+          # bullet list, even though it has more actual content. Words are a better
+          # proxy for "has substance" regardless of paragraph vs. bullet style.
           body = os.environ.get("PR_BODY") or ""
           body = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", "", body, flags=re.DOTALL)
-          count = len([line for line in body.splitlines() if line.strip()])
+          word_count = len(body.split())
 
-          print(f"Non-empty description lines: {count}")
+          print(f"Description word count: {word_count}")
 
-          if count < 10:
-              print(f"::error::PR description has only {count} non-empty line(s); at least 10 are required. "
+          if word_count < 100:
+              print(f"::error::PR description has only {word_count} word(s); at least 100 are required. "
                     "Please describe what changed, why, and how it was tested.")
               raise SystemExit(1)
           EOF
